decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal
 
It is considered that the proposed end of terrace, one bedroom dwellinghouse at 23 Southville Road, by virtue of its size, design, scale and positioning, would be overly dominant and would not have due regard for the sites characteristics and would be detrimental to both the appearance of the subject property and the character of the immediate locality.  It is considered to be an over development of the property and is therefore contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.



Condition : 2 - It is considered that the private amenity space for the proposed one bedroom dwellinghouse is too small and not of a suitable shape and would detract from its natural amenity.   The development is therefore considered to be contrary to the Private Amenity Space requirement of Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of two storey attached one bedroom dwellinghouse.
